description: This line plot illustrates the relative change in performance metrics across different layers of the Llama-3-8B-Instruct model when applying layer-wise quantized pruning via SnapKV, with results normalized against a 4×tokens,4-bit baseline. The x-axis represents the model layers, grouped into five segments: Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32, and is labeled “Layer”. The y-axis represents the “Relative Change” in performance, scaled linearly from -15% to 5%, with tick marks every 5 percentage points. Four distinct lines are plotted: a yellow line with circle markers representing “LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit”, a red line with square markers for “LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit”, a cyan line with circle markers for “RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit”, and a dark blue line with square markers for “RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit”. A dashed gray line represents the “Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit”, which remains constant at approximately 0%. The yellow line starts near 0% and slightly declines before rising to approximately +1% at Layer29-32. The red line begins near 0%, dips slightly below, and remains relatively flat near 0%. The cyan line starts near 0%, declines to approximately -6% at Layer13-20, then rises to approximately +1% at Layer29-32. The dark blue line starts near 0%, declines to approximately -15% at Layer13-20, then rises to approximately -1% at Layer29-32.
